title: Admin portal — sign in
goal: Sign in and land directly on the user list, as the role decides what that list shows.
primaryQuestion: Who am I signing in as?

zones.name: form
zones.answers: Who am I signing in as?
zones.purpose: The prototype has no identity provider, so signing in IS choosing who you are: one Select of demo identities (the Superuser and one Area Admin per area), then the template's submit. No password field: inventing one would fake a credential check the prototype does not perform.

states.empty: Not a list. Submitting with no identity chosen renders the AuthTemplate's error slot (an Alert) asking for one.
states.error: The same AuthTemplate error slot — with no identity provider behind it, an empty submit is the only error this screen can produce.

data: identities: id, name, role (superuser | area-admin), area (for area admins) — a fixed demo list in src/data/users.ts, one Superuser plus one Area Admin per area
openQuestions: The real deployment authenticates against the corporate identity provider; which one, and whether area assignment arrives as a claim or from the portal's own records, is a backend decision this prototype does not take.

behaviours.given: a signed-out visitor on the sign-in screen
behaviours.when: they choose an identity and sign in
behaviours.then: they land directly on the user list — no dashboard, no summary screen in between
behaviours.why: Requirements 4.1: no dashboard/KPI landing page; upon login, users land directly on the User List screen.
